clips.caption:
Sylvester Stallone was broke, trying to sell a movie script nobody wanted.

A producer finally said yes - but only if someone else played the lead. Stallone said no. He held out for years until one finally agreed: he would star in it himself.

That movie was Rocky. He didn't stop there - he wrote, directed, and starred in the sequels too, collecting three paychecks instead of one.

Kevin Trudeau tells this story to make one point: don't sell off the thing that makes you valuable just to get a deal done.

What are you giving away too cheaply right now?
